animations.name: Text reveal
animations.description: Splits text into words, letters or lines and animates them in. Keeps links and inline markup intact.
animations.html: Your next chapter starts here.

animations.name: Border beam
animations.description: A comet of light that travels around the element border. Set mode="full" for a continuous gradient circuit.
animations.html:
Built to move

A little light. A lasting impression.

An animated border powered by your own LumaFX library.

animations.name: Scroll reveal
animations.description: Animates the element in when it scrolls into view. Never leaves content hidden if JavaScript fails.
animations.html:
Make an entrance.

This section reveals when it enters the viewport.

animations.name: Stagger children
animations.description: Reveals each child one after another when the group scrolls into view.
animations.html:

animations.name: 3D tilt + glare
animations.description: Tilts toward the cursor in 3D with a moving light reflection. Children with data-fx-depth float above the surface.
animations.html:
Move your pointer

A new perspective.

Native depth and glare without a framework.

animations.name: Spotlight card
animations.description: A soft light and a glowing border follow the cursor across the card.
animations.html:
Follow your curiosity.

Move your pointer across this card to reveal its spotlight.

animations.name: Magnetic
animations.description: The element is pulled toward the cursor when it gets close, then springs back.
animations.html: Let’s build something

animations.name: Aurora background
animations.description: Slow, drifting aurora light behind the content of a section.
animations.html:
A brighter beginning

Ideas deserve room to shine.

animations.name: Liquid glass
animations.description: Glass surface with rim light and specular sheen. Adds real edge refraction and chromatic aberration in Chromium; frosted glass everywhere else.
animations.html:
Clear by design.

A translucent surface over your own background.

animations.name: Shimmer text
animations.description: A band of light sweeps across text. Keeps the real text selectable and accessible.
animations.html: Something extraordinary is taking shape.

animations.name: Shine sweep
animations.description: A glossy highlight sweeps across a surface such as a button or card.
animations.html: Start your next project

animations.name: Number counter
animations.description: Counts up to the number in the text when it scrolls into view. Keeps prefixes, suffixes and the original number format.
animations.html:

animations.name: Button press
animations.description: Click feedback for buttons and links: a ripple from the click point, a burst of sparks, a fill that follows the cursor in and out, or a squish. Can swap the label to a done state ("Added ✓").
animations.html: <button type="button" class="rounded-full bg-violet-600 px-8 py-4 font-semibold text-white" data-fx="press" data-fx-style="burst">Try a little motion</button>

animations.name: Rotating words
animations.description: Cycles through a list of words in place, with the width easing between them.
animations.html: Built for your ideas.

animations.name: Typewriter
animations.description: Types the text letter by letter with a blinking caret. Child lines type one after another, like a terminal.
animations.html: Create. Refine. Publish.

animations.name: SVG draw + flow
animations.description: Draws the strokes of an SVG when it scrolls into view (or with the scroll), and can send glowing pulses travelling along the paths.
animations.html: <svg class="h-28 w-full text-violet-600" data-fx="svg-draw" viewBox="0 0 400 100" fill="none" aria-label="Animated flowing line" role="img"><path d="M10 80 C80 80 60 20 130 20 S210 85 270 50 S350 20 390 20" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

animations.name: Liquid modal
animations.description: Accessible <dialog> that pulls out of the button, dock icon or link that opened it like a drop of liquid, detaches, and blooms into the panel; closing flows back into the trigger. Without a trigger it rises from the bottom edge. Open it with data-fx-open="#id", any link to href="#id", or modals.open().
animations.html:
A moment of focus.

Replace this content with your message.

animations.name: Drawer
animations.description: A side panel or bottom sheet on a <dialog>: slides in with a spring, as stretchy liquid glass, with the page shrinking back behind it, pushing the page aside to make room, docked next to a page that stays usable, or as liquid out of the button that opened it. Click outside, Esc or data-fx-close closes it with the reverse animation.
animations.html:
Room for more.

Add navigation, a form, or product details here.

animations.name: Hover icon
animations.description: Menu links slide an icon in on hover while the text makes room. Uses the data-fx-icon text, or a child marked data-fx-icon-el.
animations.html: Explore the possibilities

animations.name: Dot field
animations.description: A grid of dots that ripples away from the cursor and breathes when idle.
animations.html:
Every detail connects.

An interactive field that responds to your pointer.
